rationale: For a single-line-to-ground A-phase fault, I1 = I2 = I0 = 1 / (Z1 + Z2 + Z0 + 3Zf). The summed impedance is 0.327 + j1.42 pu, giving sequence current magnitude 0.686264 pu at -77.031908 degrees. With Ibase = 50 / (sqrt(3) * 13.8) = 2.091849 kA, each sequence current is 1.435561 kA and 3I0 is 4.306683 kA.
